name.baseName: Wood chips, post-consumer wood, burned in furnace 1000kW

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Heat of combustion of wood based on low heating value. The apparent density of the chips (humidity = 40%) is 237 kg/m3, the bulk density is 169 kg/m3, and the low heating value is 3162 MJ/m3. Air emission factors from measurements were adjusted based on operation experience of installed furnace. The inventory shall be considered valid also for boilers with nominal capacity in the approximate range of 700 kW to some MW. ; UUID: f6761524-6bcb-398c-b8ab-9e222c79c502

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: Some emission data used to calculate averages are from the second half of the 1990´s.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Boiler of average technology available on market.

# Included processes
This module describes the combustion of natural wood chips. Included are the infrastructure, the wood requirements (softwood chips from industry, u=40%), the emissions to air, the transport of the fuel, the electricity needed for operation, and the disposal of the ashes.
